key_values.event_name: Storm Boris Central and Eastern Europe floods

provenance.notes: Ground truth is regenerated from package metadata, the locked event anchor, and the ECMWF Storm Boris report.

criteria.description: Returns the label basin_river_flood_dominant with a score of 4 out of 4.
criteria.name: Final ledger result
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the right label with no score or a score off by one; 1 point for a vague river-flood conclusion.

criteria.description: Uses the 442 mm three-day rainfall value and correctly marks the 300 mm threshold test as passed.
criteria.name: Rainfall threshold test
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a correct extreme-rain claim with a missing threshold, wrong unit, or minor value error.

criteria.description: Uses the at-least-20-year Oder River basin signal and correctly marks the return-period threshold test as passed.
criteria.name: Oder severity test
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recognizing severe Oder flooding but omitting the at-least qualifier or threshold comparison.

criteria.description: Uses 8,500 km of rivers beyond twice average annual maximum flow and correctly marks the 5,000 km extent test as passed.
criteria.name: River amplification test
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mentioning widespread high flows with an incomplete value or comparison.

criteria.description: Computes 7 divided by 27 as about 0.259 and rejects a flash-flood-only explanation because it is below one third.
criteria.name: Flash-only rejection
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using the 7 and 27 counts but missing the ratio or the one-third comparison.

criteria.description: States or clearly applies the four pass/fail tests and the all-four-pass decision rule.
criteria.name: Formula and threshold clarity
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the tests are implicit but the arithmetic mostly supports the final label.

criteria.description: Returns a compact JSON-style answer with the requested fields and no action advice or broad event essay.
criteria.name: Concise constrained output
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a readable answer that has minor formatting problems or extra prose but remains scoreable.
